general.title: General
general.description: Choose the app language, appearance, and startup behavior

taskbar.title: Taskbar
taskbar.description: Customize the taskbar player's layout, appearance, and content

data.title: Data
data.description: Manage cached lyrics, app settings, and runtime logs

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Check the status of the taskbar, media sessions, lyrics, and audio features

about.title: About
about.description: View version, update, and open-source project information

language.title: Display language
language.description: Choose the language used throughout Muse Tune

colorMode.title: Color mode
colorMode.description: Use a light or dark theme, or match the Windows setting

reducedMotion.title: Reduce motion
reducedMotion.description: Reduce lyric, artwork, and interface animations; when off, follow the Windows motion setting

autostart.title: Launch at startup
autostart.description: Start Muse Tune automatically when you sign in to Windows

placement.title: Component placement
placement.description: Place the component on the left or right; Automatic adapts to the taskbar layout

horizontalOffset.title: Horizontal offset
horizontalOffset.description: Move from the default position; positive values move right and negative values move left, in pixels

overlap.title: Overlap priority
overlap.description: When space is limited, let Muse Tune overlap taskbar items or clip it to avoid them

autoHide.title: Auto-hide
autoHide.description: Hide the component when no media session exists or playback is paused
autoHide.noSessionDescription: Hide the component when Windows has no available media session
autoHide.pausedDescription: Hide the component when the current media session is paused

transparency.title: Background transparency
transparency.description: Adjust the theme background transparency without affecting text or controls
transparency.coverDisabled: Blurred artwork uses its own effect; switch to the theme background to adjust transparency

backgroundStyle.title: Background style
backgroundStyle.description: Use the theme background or blurred artwork as the component background
backgroundStyle.progressFallback: Blurred artwork and full-height progress cannot be used together. Continuing will switch progress to the bottom bar.
backgroundStyle.backgroundFallback: Full-height progress and blurred artwork cannot be used together. Continuing will switch to the theme background.

width.title: Component width
width.description: Choose a preset, set a custom width, or fill the available taskbar space
width.autoHint: Fills the available taskbar space with a minimum width of 200px

display.title: Target display
display.description: Choose which displays show the component on their taskbar

controls.title: Playback controls
controls.description: Choose which playback controls appear and how they are arranged
controls.visibleDescription: Show or hide the entire group of playback controls
controls.buttonsDescription: Choose which buttons to show, then drag to reorder them
controls.volumeTargetDescription: Adjust the current player's audio session or take over the system master volume of the default Windows playback device. Hover over the taskbar player and scroll the mouse wheel to adjust it
controls.volumeRestoreDescription: After switching to system master volume, the taskbar will no longer adjust the current player's individual volume. Restore it to 100% and unmute it first?
controls.volumeRestoreFailed: Could not restore the current player volume

cover.title: Artwork
cover.description: Configure artwork visibility, shape, and playback effects
cover.visibleDescription: Show artwork in normal mode, lyrics mode, or both
cover.shapeDescription: Choose how the artwork is cropped
cover.rotateDescription: Rotate continuously during playback and hold the current position while paused
cover.sourceDescription: Show the current player's icon in the lower-right corner of the artwork

elementOrder.title: Element order
elementOrder.description: Set element order independently for normal and lyrics modes

progress.title: Playback progress
progress.description: Configure the style and position of the playback progress indicator
progress.styleDescription: Use a horizontal bar, a ring around the cover, or a full-height gradient
progress.positionDescription: Place the progress bar at the top or bottom

spectrum.title: Audio spectrum
spectrum.description: Visualize audio from the current player in real time
spectrum.visibleDescription: Turning this off stops audio capture and spectrum processing
spectrum.barCountDescription: Fewer bars create a simpler look; more bars show finer frequency detail
spectrum.widthDescription: Set the width of the right-aligned spectrum; it overlays content in normal mode and occupies its own space in lyrics mode
spectrum.verticalDescription: Centered bars expand both ways; bottom-aligned bars grow upward
spectrum.sensitivityDescription: Adjust how strongly the spectrum responds to the input level
spectrum.smoothingDescription: Higher values produce steadier motion but react more slowly
spectrum.frameRateDescription: Lower frame rates reduce spectrum sampling, communication, and rendering work

trackInfo.title: Track information
trackInfo.description: Configure track information alignment and title scrolling
trackInfo.visibleDescription: When off, hide the title and artist and free the space for other elements
trackInfo.alignmentDescription: Align the title and artist within the available area
trackInfo.scrollDescription: When off, truncate titles that exceed the available width
trackInfo.speedDescription: Set the movement speed in pixels per second
trackInfo.modeDescription: Choose how the title moves after reaching the end

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.description: Configure lyric content, appearance, and timing on the taskbar
lyrics.enabledDescription: When off, restore track information and playback controls
lyrics.linesDescription: Choose one or two lines; two-line mode lets you select the secondary content
lyrics.secondaryDescription: Translation first automatically shows the next line when no translation is available
lyrics.chineseVariantDescription: Convert the song title, artist, and lyrics between Simplified and Traditional Chinese; Follow interface preserves source text when the interface is in English
lyrics.wordHighlightDescription: Available only for lyrics that include word-level timing
lyrics.alignmentDescription: Align lyrics within the available horizontal space
lyrics.sizeDescription: Choose 10–18px; two-line mode automatically uses tighter spacing
lyrics.colorsDescription: Use the component accent color or set played and unplayed colors separately
lyrics.playedColorDescription: Text already reached in word-timed lyrics
lyrics.unplayedColorDescription: Used for upcoming text and the second lyric line
lyrics.fontDescription: Use an installed Windows font; opening the list discovers newly installed fonts
lyrics.animationDescription: Choose how lyrics move or fade when the active line changes
lyrics.preRollOn: On: finishes the transition just before the lyric timestamp for tighter timing; during continuous vocals, the previous line may leave early.
lyrics.preRollOff: Off: starts the transition at the lyric timestamp, in sync with the vocals.
lyrics.offsetDescription: Calibrate lyric timing: positive values delay lyrics and negative values advance them without changing transition lead time
lyrics.networkDescription: Allow online lookup, or use only local lyrics and the existing cache
lyrics.parallelDescription: Queries multiple sources at once. This is usually faster but makes more network requests. The current player's service always takes part and moves to the front when it is not selected.
lyrics.onlineSourcesDescription: Choose which online sources may be queried and drag to set their priority; disabled sources receive no requests, except the current player's service

mediaSession.title: Player selection
mediaSession.description: Choose which player Muse Tune displays when multiple media sessions are available
mediaSession.strategyDescription: Most recently played switches only when a player starts playback; simply opening an app does not take over
mediaSession.supportedOnlyDescription: Use media sessions only from QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Soda Music, Kugou Music, and Spotify
mediaSession.priorityDescription: When multiple players are playing, choose the first one in this list

theme.title: Component accent color
theme.description: Use artwork color, the Windows accent, or a custom color for progress, spectrum, and volume controls
theme.presetsDescription: Choose a preset color and apply it immediately
theme.customDescription: Enter a hexadecimal color in #RRGGBB format
theme.invalidColor: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color, for example #1677ff

cache.title: Lyrics cache
cache.description: Manage lyrics cached by Muse Tune
cache.clearConfirmDescription: All cached lyrics will be deleted and retrieved again as needed during playback.
cache.currentClearedDescription: The current song's lyrics were removed from the Muse Tune cache
cache.refreshStartedDescription: Muse Tune will run the complete retrieval process again using the current network settings

config.title: App settings
config.description: Manage saved app settings and preferences
config.resetConfirmDescription: All settings will return to their defaults and Muse Tune will restart. This cannot be undone.

logs.title: Runtime logs
logs.description: Review app activity and recorded errors
logs.clearConfirmDescription: Archived log files will be deleted. The active log will remain and continue recording without restarting the app.
logs.fileDescription: Includes the active log and archived files

update.title: App updates
update.source: Stable releases are provided through GitHub Releases
update.automaticDescription: Check for new versions at the selected interval while Muse Tune is running
update.installConfirmDescription: After the download finishes, Muse Tune will close and install the update. Continue?
update.saveAutomaticFailed: Could not save automatic update checks
update.saveFrequencyFailed: Could not save the update check interval
update.notificationTitle: A Muse Tune update is available
update.notificationBody: Version {version} is available. Open Settings → About to download and install it.

project.title: Project and license
project.openFailed: Could not open the link in your default browser

diagnostics.autoRefresh: Refreshes when media or lyrics change · {time}
diagnostics.copyFailed: Could not copy the diagnostic report

audio.title: Audio capabilities
audio.description: Windows app audio session and per-process spectrum capture status

taskbar.title: Taskbar
taskbar.description: Windows taskbar detection and Muse Tune Bar window status

adapters.title: Player adapters
adapters.description: Automatic folder discovery and file event watching for the five supported players

media.title: Media session
media.description: Player, metadata, and controls selected by Windows GSMTC
media.noControls: The player did not declare any available controls

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.description: Original lyric source and how lyrics were retrieved for this playback
